label: Bible Study
prompt: Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy _____, while the evil days come not, nor the years draw nigh, when thou shalt say, I have no pleasure in them;
verse: Remember now thy Creator in the days of thy youth, while the evil days come not, nor the years draw nigh, when thou shalt say, I have no pleasure in them;
note: The Preacher's advice to the young — remember your Creator before the hard days arrive.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And all this assembly shall know that the LORD saveth not with sword and spear: for the _____ is the LORD'S, and he will give you into our hands.
verse: And all this assembly shall know that the LORD saveth not with sword and spear: for the battle is the LORD'S, and he will give you into our hands.
note: David's pre-fight speech to Goliath: no sword needed when the battle belongs to someone bigger than the giant.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And he ran before, and climbed up into a _____ tree to see him: for he was to pass that way.
verse: And he ran before, and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see him: for he was to pass that way.
note: The KJV spells it 'sycomore' — a sturdy fig tree, perfect for a short tax collector named Zacchaeus.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the _____ his spots? then may ye also do good, that are accustomed to do evil.
verse: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? then may ye also do good, that are accustomed to do evil.
note: Jeremiah's proverb on habitual sin: some stains you can't scrub out yourself — hence the new-covenant promise later in his book.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Hope _____ maketh the heart sick: but when the desire cometh, it is a tree of life.
verse: Hope deferred maketh the heart sick: but when the desire cometh, it is a tree of life.
note: 'Hope deferred' — put off, postponed — and Proverbs admits it makes the heart sick. Honest wisdom.
